tools.name: create_lyric_video
tools.description: Turns a song the user attached (MP3/WAV) into a word-synced lyric video and proposes three visual styles. Pass the lyrics if the user gave them; otherwise they are transcribed from the audio. Takes about 10–40 seconds. Creates a new project each call.

tools.name: get_lyric_video
tools.description: Returns a lyric video project's processing status, its three style options, the style now applied, and its numbered lyric lines.

tools.name: choose_style
tools.description: Applies one of the three proposed style options (1, 2 or 3) to the lyric video. Replaces any edits made to the current style.

tools.name: update_style
tools.description: Changes the look of the current lyric video style: layout, word animation, colors, font, text size, background, and chorus emphasis. Send only the fields to change. Colors are #RRGGBB. Unreadable color combinations and unknown fonts are corrected or rejected with a reason.

tools.name: edit_lyrics
tools.description: Replaces the text of one lyric line (numbered from 1, as listed by get_lyric_video), keeping its timing. Use it to fix misheard or misspelled words.

tools.name: export_video
tools.description: Free export: a 720p, 16:9 MP4 with a small watermark and a 2.5-second end card. It renders on the user's own computer inside the widget (about as long as the song), so this tool shows the widget and starts the export there; the user downloads the MP4 from the widget when it finishes. If their ChatGP

tools.name: begin_local_export
tools.description: Widget only: reserve a free 720p export to render in the browser.

tools.name: upload_local_export
tools.description: Widget only: storage upload target for a browser-rendered MP4.

tools.name: finish_local_export
tools.description: Widget only: complete a browser-rendered export after its upload, or fail it with an error.

tools.name: open_in_browser
tools.description: Widget only: a short-lived link that opens this project in the user's browser, where it can be exported.

tools.name: export_hd_video
tools.description: Renders the lyric video in 1080p without a watermark, as 16:9 (landscape) or 9:16 (vertical). Requires the user's LyricVideoGenerator account: it uses 1 credit from their plan (or is free if this song was already unlocked on the website). Credits are refunded if the render fails. Returns an exportId

tools.name: get_export
tools.description: Returns the status of a video export and, when finished, its MP4 download URL.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_export · Public sink: update_style, upload_local_export, finish_local_export.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_export · Public sink: update_style, upload_local_export, finish_local_export

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
